notes.title: 5th Anniversary Update: Apocalypse Mode
notes.notes:
For the 5th anniversary of Breaking Lockdown (a little late, I know), here comes a big update featuring:

Lighting optimizations to improve performance

An Apocalypse Mode for the toughest players out there

And even a little surprise for those who manage to beat Apocalypse Mode

Jenny is waiting for you — it’s time to break the lockdown!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1336420/Breaking_Lockdown/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Wild Dose Demo - Major Update
notes.notes:
Use all available skills to complete quests and uncover the secrets of Eleftheria!

Main contents:
- a smoother and more psychological-horror version of the Loading Zone
- use the Technology skill to hack the tank terminal in Eleftheria

This Major Update (patches excepted) will be the last for several months. Being still a solo developer, it becomes complicated to maintain this demo while the full game has evolved in parallel.

Enjoy this update and don't forget to add Wild Dose to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555790/Wild_Dose/

Maxime
